notes: Owned by the human operator. Patterns are relative to the service root (the directory holding this file); '~/' means the home directory. A trailing '/' protects a whole subtree; '*' and '?' match inside one path segment only. 'except' lifts protection for matching paths and is the place for instance-specific carve-outs. 'volatile' lists protected paths whose content changes at run time; they stay write-protected but are left out of protected_manifest.json.

except.reason: This instance treats the static UI as Tier 0 (data/workspace/SELF-MODIFY.md rule 2). Delete this entry to protect it, which is the default for a shipped copy.
